# Copilot Instructions for myblog

This is a Docusaurus 3.9 documentation site with blog functionality, built with TypeScript and React.

## Build, Test & Lint Commands

All commands require Node >=20.0 and use pnpm.

**Development:**
- `npm start` or `pnpm start` – Start local dev server with hot reload (http://localhost:3000)
- `npm run dev` – Alternative dev command with polling (useful in some environments)

**Production:**
- `npm run build` – Generate static site to `build/` directory
- `npm run serve` – Serve the built site locally

**Type Checking:**
- `npm run typecheck` – Run TypeScript type checking without emitting

**Testing (Playwright):**
- `npm run test` – Run all Playwright tests headless
- `npm run test:ui` – Run tests with interactive UI (great for debugging)
- `npm run test:headed` – Run tests in visible browser windows
- `npm run test:debug` – Run single test with debugger

Tests are located in `tests/` and use `*.spec.ts` naming. Playwright automatically starts the dev server.

**Utilities:**
- `npm run clear` – Clear Docusaurus cache and generated files
- `npm run write-heading-ids` – Auto-generate heading IDs in markdown files
- `npm run write-translations` – Extract translatable strings (i18n config exists but only 'en' is active)
- `npm run swizzle` – Customize Docusaurus theme components

## Project Structure & Architecture

**Content:**
- `docs/` – Main documentation pages (autogenerated sidebar from filesystem)
- `blog/` – Blog posts in `YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md{,x}` format with optional asset folders
- `blog/authors.yml` – Blog author metadata
- `blog/tags.yml` – Blog post tags

**Customization:**
- `src/pages/` – Custom React pages (homepage is here)
- `src/components/` – Reusable React components (exported as `.tsx` with co-located `.module.css`)
- `src/css/custom.css` – Global CSS with Infima CSS variables (theming)

**Configuration:**
- `docusaurus.config.ts` – Main site configuration (title, baseUrl, plugins, presets, i18n)
- `sidebars.ts` – Sidebar structure (uses autogenerated from filesystem by default)
- `tsconfig.json` – TypeScript config with Docusaurus preset
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` – Monorepo configuration (currently minimal)

**Dependencies:**
- React 19 + React DOM (from `@docusaurus/preset-classic`)
- MDX support for `.mdx` blog posts
- Prism React Renderer for code syntax highlighting
- Infima CSS framework (theming via CSS variables)

## Key Conventions

**Content Formatting:**
- Blog posts use YAML frontmatter: `title`, `authors` (array of author keys from `authors.yml`), `tags` (optional)
- Markdown uses standard syntax; Docusaurus extends it with features like [tabs](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/tabs), [admonitions](https://docusaurus.io/docs/markdown-features/admonitions), etc.
- Code blocks support language-specific syntax highlighting and line highlighting

**Component Structure:**
- Components use TypeScript with `React.ComponentType<>` for type-safe prop passing
- CSS modules named `*.module.css` are co-located with components
- Utility classnames are managed with `clsx()` for conditional classes
- Docusaurus theme components imported from `@theme/*` (e.g., `Heading`, `Layout`)

**TypeScript:**
- Use strict TypeScript with the Docusaurus preset (`@docusaurus/tsconfig`)
- Import paths use `@site/` alias for root-relative imports (configured in Docusaurus)
- Component types should extend `ReactNode` for return types

**Styling:**
- Global theming via CSS variables in `src/css/custom.css` (use `--ifm-*` prefix for Infima overrides)
- Module-scoped CSS for component-specific styles
- Utility classes from Infima grid (`col col--4`, `text--center`, etc.)

**Testing (Playwright):**
- Configuration: `playwright.config.ts` (baseURL: http://localhost:3000, runs dev server automatically)
- Tests use `page.goto()` for navigation, `page.locator()` for element selection, and `expect()` assertions
- Key locator strategies: CSS selectors (`.class`, `h1`), text matching (`'a:has-text("text")'`), role-based (`button`)
- Common patterns: `await expect(element).toBeVisible()`, `await expect(page).toHaveURL()`, `await expect(locator).toContainText()`
- Viewport testing: Use `page.setViewportSize()` to test responsive design (mobile: 375x667, tablet: 768x1024)
- Use `test.describe()` for grouping related tests; each test runs in isolation

**Future Flag:**
- `v4` is enabled in config—site is prepared for Docusaurus v4 compatibility
